title.zh: 板块构造 · 三种边界
title.en: Plate tectonics · three kinds of boundary

description.zh: 地球的硬外壳碎成许多板块，漂在缓慢流动的软流圈上，每年只移动几厘米：相互分离处长出新地壳（洋中脊），相互汇聚处一块俯冲到另一块下面（海沟、火山、山脉），相互错动处应力积累、突然释放成地震。
description.en: The Earth’s rigid shell is broken into plates riding on the slowly flowing asthenosphere, moving only a few centimetres a year: where they pull apart new crust forms (mid-ocean ridges), where they converge one dives beneath the other (trenches, volcanoes, mountains), and where they slide past each other stress builds and is released as earthquakes.

label.zh: 地震既是证据，也是探针
label.en: Earthquakes are both evidence and probe

reason.zh: 地震集中发生在板块边界，是板块相对运动最直接的野外证据；同样这些地震发出的波穿过地球内部，揭示了板块下方会流动的那一层。
reason.en: Earthquakes cluster along plate boundaries, the most direct field evidence of relative plate motion; the waves from those same earthquakes travel through the interior and reveal the flowing layer beneath the plates.
